51410-dr-elsie-inglis.title: Dr. Elsie Inglis
51410-dr-elsie-inglis.creator: Lady Frances Balfour
51410-dr-elsie-inglis.description: A book by Lady Frances Balfour. that year the property of Kingsmills, Inverness-shire, was in the hands of Hugh Inglis. He had three sons, George, Alexander, and William. George inherited Kingsmills, and the Inglis now in Inverness are descended from him. Alexander, the great-grandfather of Elsie, married Mary Deas, and about 1780 emigrated to Carolina, leaving his four children to be educated in Scotland, in charge of his brother, William Inglis.

arxiv-2008-00853.title: Predicting the Humorousness of Tweets Using Gaussian Process Preference Learning
arxiv-2008-00853.creator: Tristan Miller, Erik-Lân Do Dinh, Edwin Simpson, Iryna Gurevych
arxiv-2008-00853.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Humour is an essential part of everyday communication, particularly in social media [ Holton and Lewis,2011 , Shifman,2013 ] , yet it remains a challenge for computational methods. Unlike conventional language, humour requires complex linguistic and background knowledge to understand, which are difficult to integrate with NLP methods [ Hempelmann,2008 ] .

arxiv-2104-04553.title: SPoTKD: A Protocol for Symmetric Key Distribution over Public Channels Using Self-Powered Timekeeping Devices
arxiv-2104-04553.creator: Mustafizur Rahman, Liang Zhou, and Shantanu Chakrabartty
arxiv-2104-04553.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a novel class of symmetric key distribution protocols that leverages basic security primitives offered by low-cost, hardware chipsets containing millions of synchronized self-powered timers. The keys are derived from the temporal dynamics of a physical, micro-scale time-keeping device which makes the keys immune to any potential side-channel attacks, malicious tampering, or snooping.

arxiv-2106-12408.title: The SKIM-FA Kernel: High-Dimensional Variable Selection and Nonlinear Interaction Discovery in Linear Time
arxiv-2106-12408.creator: Raj Agrawal r.agrawal@mit.edu, Tamara Broderick tbroderick@mit.edu
arxiv-2106-12408.description: Abstract Many scientific problems require identifying a small set of covariates that are associated with a target response and estimating their effects. Often, these effects are nonlinear and include interactions, so linear and additive methods can lead to poor estimation and variable selection.

arxiv-2205-04872.title: Steered discrete-time quantum walks for engineering of quantum states
arxiv-2205-04872.creator: Gururaj Kadiri
arxiv-2205-04872.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gururaj Kadiri. We analyze the strengths and limitations of steered discrete time quantum walks in generating quantum states of bipartite quantum systems comprising of a qubit coupled to a qudit system. We demonstrate that not all quantum states in the composite space are accessible through quantum walks, even under the most generalized definition of a quantum step, leading to a bifurcation of the composite Hilbert space into “walk-accessible states” and the “walk-inaccessible states”.

arxiv-2211-05652.title: On uniqueness for half-wave maps in dimension d ≥ 3 d\geq 3
arxiv-2211-05652.creator: Eugene Eyeson, Silvino Reyes Farina, Armin Schikorra
arxiv-2211-05652.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Eugene Eyeson, Silvino Reyes Farina, Armin Schikorra. Extending an argument by Shatah and Struwe we obtain uniqueness for solutions of the half-wave map equation in dimension d ≥ 3 d\geq 3 in the natural energy class. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 35L05, 35B40 1. Introduction and main result Half-wave maps appear in the physics literature as the continuum limit of Calagero-Moser spin systems, see [ 13 ] and references within.

arxiv-2302-08412.title: Steric engineering of point defects in lead halide perovskites
arxiv-2302-08412.creator: Lucy D. Whalley
arxiv-2302-08412.description: Abstract Due to their high photovoltaic efficiency and low-cost synthesis, lead halide perovskites have attracted wide interest for application in new solar cell technologies. The most stable and efficient ABX 3 \text{ABX}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{3}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{3}}\text{}} perovskite solar cells employ mixed A-site cations, however the impact of cation mixing on carrier trapping and recombination—key processes that limit photovoltaic performance—is not fully understood.

arxiv-2310-03852.title: How weak values illuminate the role of “hidden”-variables as predictive tools
arxiv-2310-03852.creator: Xabier Oianguren-Asua, Albert Solé, Carlos F. Destefani, Xavier Oriols
arxiv-2310-03852.description: Abstract ABSTRACT In this chapter we offer an introduction to weak values from a three-fold perspective: first, outlining the protocols that enable their experimental determination; next, deriving their correlates in the quantum formalism and, finally, discussing their ontological significance according to different quantum theories or interpretations.

arxiv-2311-09785.title: Enforcing Timing Properties in Motorway Traffic
arxiv-2311-09785.creator: Christopher Bischopink
arxiv-2311-09785.description: Abstract In previous work [ 5 ] , we proposed a Runtime Enforcement Approach to deal with timing properties in motorway traffic, which are present in form of Timed Multi-Lane Spatial Logic (TMLSL) formulae, a logic tailored to express both spatial and timing properties.

arxiv-2503-24251.title: Combining Query Performance Predictors: A Reproducibility Study
arxiv-2503-24251.creator: Sourav Saha Suchana Datta, Dwaipayan Roy, Mandar Mitra, Derek Greene
arxiv-2503-24251.description: Abstract A large number of approaches to Query Performance Prediction (QPP) have been proposed over the last two decades. As early as 2009, Hauff et al. [ 28 ] explored whether different QPP methods may be combined to improve prediction quality. Since then, significant research has been done both on QPP approaches, as well as their evaluation.

arxiv-2510-03450.title: Rotation of intrinsic orbital angular momentum and the orbital Hall effect for twisted particles in arbitrary gravitational fields
arxiv-2510-03450.creator: Alexander J. Silenko
arxiv-2510-03450.description: Abstract For twisted particles in arbitrary gravitational fields, the problems of the rotation of intrinsic orbital angular momentum and the orbital Hall effect are solved in the general case. We need not use the Maxwell equations in curved spacetimes for a description of twisted photons. The exact general equation rigorously defining the OAM dynamics in any Riemannian spacetimes is derived.

arxiv-2604-16126.title: Cells, convexity and contractibility in general categories
arxiv-2604-16126.creator: Suddhasattwa Das

pmc-10555193.title: FRI626 Association Between Fasting Serum C-peptide Values And The Presence Of Chronic Kidney Disease In Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
pmc-10555193.creator: Laura Leyva Figueroa, Francisco J Gomez-Perez, Fernando Gonzalez-Valdivia, Daniel Cuevas-Ramos
pmc-10555193.description: Disclosure: L. Leyva Figueroa: None. F.J. Gomez-Perez: None. F. Gonzalez-Valdivia: None. D. Cuevas-Ramos: None. Background: High C-peptide levels have been associated with microvascular complications, although there is controversial evidence in patients with T2DM. Objective: To correlate fasting serum C-peptide values in patients with T2DM with diabetic nephropathy.

pmc-10650674.title: The Effects of Potato Presentation on Vegetable Intake in School-Aged Children: A Cross-Over Study
pmc-10650674.creator: Mayra G. Hernandez Sanchez, Sarah Bellini, William F. Christensen, Laura K. Jefferies, James D. LeCheminant, Emily V. Patten, Alisha H. Redelfs, Nathan Stokes, Jacklyn Wang, Micaela Rennick, Kelsey Anderson, Joli Hunt, Gene J. Ahlborn
pmc-10650674.description: Vegetables are an essential component of a healthy dietary pattern in children; however, their consumption is often insufficient due to lack of preference. To address this, the influence of combining vegetables (mixed peas and carrots—MPACs) with potatoes, a generally liked food, on overall vegetable consumption among children aged 7–13 years was explored.

pmc-11353534.title: Incoherence: A Generalized Measure of Complexity to Quantify Ensemble Divergence in Multi-Trial Experiments and Simulations
pmc-11353534.creator: Timothy Davey, Carlos Gershenson, Juval Portugali
pmc-11353534.description: Complex systems pose significant challenges to traditional scientific and statistical methods due to their inherent unpredictability and resistance to simplification. Accurately detecting complex behavior and the uncertainty which comes with it is therefore essential. Using the context of previous studies, we introduce a new information-theoretic measure, termed “incoherence”.

pmc-11435140.title: A Newly Validated HPLC-DAD Method for the Determination of Ricinoleic Acid (RA) in PLGA Nanocapsules
pmc-11435140.creator: Lucas Rannier M de Andrade, Larissa F dos Santos, Débora S Pires, Érika P Machado, Marco Antonio U Martines, Maria Ligia R Macedo, Teófilo Fernando M Cardoso, Patrícia Severino, Eliana B Souto, Najla M Kassab, Sabina Lachowicz-Wiśniewska
pmc-11435140.description: The assessment of ricinoleic acid (RA) incorporated into polymeric nanoparticles is a challenge that has not yet been explored. This bioactive compound, the main component of castor oil, has attracted attention in the pharmaceutical field for its valuable anti-inflammatory, antifungal, and antimicrobial properties.

pmc-11454875.title: 7435 Thyroid Abscess Post-FNA in an Immunocompetent Host
pmc-11454875.creator: Bharat Gautam, Md Shajjad Hossain, Sadaf Hossain, Salini Chellappan Kumar, Huijuan Liao, Bishal Tiwari, David S Rosenthal
pmc-11454875.description: Disclosure: B. Gautam: None. M.S. Hossain: None. S. Hossain: None. S.C. Kumar: None. H. liao: None. B. Tiwari: None. D.S. Rosenthal: None. Background: Thyroid Fine Needle Aspiration (FNA) is a common diagnostic procedure for thyroid nodules. Most common post FNA complications are minor pain, bruises and small hematomas.

pmc-11619614.title: Value of intraoperative post-conisation human papillomavirus testing in predicting residual or recurrence after treatment with a loop electrosurgical excision procedure in women with HR-HPV positive and cervical high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion
pmc-11619614.creator: Weiting Xia, Xinyue Dai, Yan Hu, Simeng Yang, Chen Chen, Xiaolin Li
pmc-11619614.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the feasibility of intraoperative human papillomavirus (IOP-HPV) testing for the prediction of postoperative treatment failure in patients with high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion (HSIL) undergoing loop electrosurgical excisional procedure (LEEP).MethodsA total of 114 women diagnosed with HSIL by biopsy and/or endocervical curettage who underwent LEEP were included in a prospective cohort study.

pmc-12362454.title: Prevalence and Factors Associated With the Informal Market for Medicines in Benin: A Community‐Based Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-12362454.creator: A. Narcisse D. Agbanou, Fernand A. Gbaguidi, Fidèle Zinsou, Yossounon Chabi, Habib Ganfon
pmc-12362454.description: Background and AimsMedicines are intended to improve the health of individuals with various medical conditions, but their poor‐quality poses significant risks, especially in low‐ and middle‐income countries like Benin, where informally sold medicines are widely consumed. This study assessed the prevalence and factors associated with their consumption in Benin.MethodsConducted in 2018 across 72 districts of Cotonou, it targeted 864 households.

pmc-12424152.title: Bibliometric analysis of the association between air pollution and allergic rhinitis
pmc-12424152.creator: Zhigang Geng, Yuqiang Ma, Xueping Qi
pmc-12424152.description: BackgroundAllergic rhinitis (AR) is an increasingly prominent global public health issue, where air pollution significantly contributes to its rising incidence. Although numerous studies have explored the link between air pollution and AR pathogenesis, comprehensive summaries are still limited.ObjectiveThis study performs a bibliometric analysis to identify research hotspots and emerging trends, offering insights into AR prevention and management.

pmc-12499497.title: Explaining health behavior: a new model centered around health experience and its determinants
pmc-12499497.creator: Damien S. E. Broekharst, Sjaak Bloem, Edward A. G. Groenland, Tessa S. Folkertsma, Jim Ingebretsen Carlson, Frans Folkvord, Claire Everitt, Aad R. Liefveld, Giuseppe Fico, Francisco Lupiáñez-Villanueva
pmc-12499497.description: IntroductionConventional health-related models used to predict health behaviors have limited predictive power, as they fail to accurately capture an individual’s health experience, which correlates more closely with health behavior. Therefore, some researchers have aimed to develop a predictive model focused on subjective health experience and its determinants. Although this model may be promising, it is still rudimentary.

pmc-12618485.title: Simultaneous determination of soil-water characteristic and shrinkage curves of consolidated kaolin under continuous and discrete drying procedures
pmc-12618485.creator: Hengshuo Liu, Harianto Rahardjo, Yangyang Li
pmc-12618485.description: Soil-water characteristic curve (SWCC) and shrinkage curve are essential information required for analyzing the behaviors and properties of unsaturated soils. This study proposes a new method for simultaneous measurement of SWCC and shrinkage curve of a “single” soil specimen. The validation of the method was carried out using kaolin specimens prepared at low levels of consolidation pressures.

pmc-13056079.title: Non-ergodicity in ecology and evolution
pmc-13056079.creator: Teemu Kuosmanen, Alexandre Minetto, Ville Mustonen
pmc-13056079.description: SignificanceThe effects of stochasticity can be averaged in two ways: over a population of individuals and over time along individual trajectories. If the encountered states and collected payoffs along any given trajectory eventually match the expected statistics of the population, the generating process satisfies the mathematical property of ergodicity, which is a key assumption for many models of complex systems.

pmc-13312647.title: GEO uploader: simplifying the data deposition in the GEO repository
pmc-13312647.creator: Ronald Domi, Falko Noé, Peter Leary, Hubert Rehrauer
pmc-13312647.description: BackgroundThe Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) (Clough and Barrett in: methods in molecular biology, Clifton, 2016) repository requires complex multistep submissions involving metadata preparation, FTP uploads, and MD5 validation. Current manual processes are error-prone, time-consuming, and require significant bioinformatics expertise, creating barriers for many researchers.

pmc-13520284.title: Coaches’ perspectives on training quality in elite para-sport: a qualitative study of coach–athlete collaboration
pmc-13520284.creator: Vemund Øvstehage, Jan Kocbach, Cecilia Severin, Knut Skovereng, Silvana Bucher Sandbakk, Øyvind Sandbakk

pmc-13548462.creator: Deepa Patel, Shahriyar Shahbazi Khamas, Pia Maier, Refika Ersu, Alexander Moeller, Susanne J.H. Vijverberg
pmc-13548462.description: Shareable abstract#ERSCongress 2025: surge in youth #vaping, new evidence on exposome-driven risks, advances in rare paediatric lung diseases. Strong global collaboration remains essential to support low-resource settings and reduce growing respiratory #healthinequities. https://bit.ly/4tv2mrz Introduction Lung health starts early in life. There is increasing awareness that lung-function trajectories are shaped by complex interactions of genetic profiles, environmental, and social factors [1].

pmc-13723517.title: Towards smart sterile supply cycles
pmc-13723517.creator: Ha Uyen Nguyen, Lea Kristin Stoll, Klaus Radermacher, Jan Heibeyn
pmc-13723517.description: Purpose:The sterile supply cycle (SSC) is fundamental to perioperative care but remains fragmented and largely operated as an open-loop process in which deviations are often detected only in the operating room (OR). Current smart hospital concepts mainly address patient-centred systems and insufficiently integrate perioperative material logistics and sterile supply processes.
